$comment: Plot-edge roles (front / rear / side-a / side-b / other) as the rules engine and the plot editor must BOTH derive them. Hand-written from the definition in apps/api/garh_api/compliance.py::_edge_roles (mirrored by apps/web/src/features/plot/geometry.ts::edgeRoles): front = widest road (ties -> lowest index); rear = outward normal within 45 deg of directly away from the front; the rest side-a / side-b by which half of the plot they sit in as seen FROM THE ROAD looking in (A = left, B = right — the engine's copy says 'left side' / 'right side'). Asserted by apps/api/tests/test_edge_roles.py and apps/web/src/features/plot/plot.test.ts. Rings are integer mm.

cases.name: 30x40 rectangle, road on the bottom edge: left (west) is side A
rectangle, road on the east edge: looking west, the south edge is on the left
L-plot: both back faces are rear, the notch's side is a side (parity picked edge 3 as rear)
trapezoid: skewed sides are sides, the top is rear
right triangle: the hypotenuse faces away enough to be rear
no road at all: every edge is other
corner plot: the wider road is the front
two equal roads: the lower edge index is the front
clockwise rectangle (a dragged corner can flip a ring): normals still point outward, left is still west
road width null on the only road: no front, every edge other
a road index past the ring is ignored
